svg.title: Pass rate by task tag
svg.desc: Which kinds of task does the model get right? Over all tasks 63% passed; by tag, best first: trap: unsafe bait 95% of 20, simple 89% of 140, trap: missing server 85% of 20, trap: missing entity 84% of 45, slices 81% of 280, question: monitor 78% of 65, short prompt 64% of 325, traps 63% of 200, complexity: moderate 63% of 325, complexity: simple 63% of 255, question: decide 63% of 190, question: diagnose 62% of 220, complexity: complex 62% of 200, question: research 60% of 205, arithmetic 60% of 60, question: forecast 57% of 100, trap: missing tool 57% of 30, follow-ups (= multi-turn) 49% of 435, long 49% of 445, scenarios 48% of 320, complex 46% of 360, writes 45% of 225, trap: vague 45% of 20, trap: approval flow 40% of 30, multi-system 39% of 300, trap: false premise 33% of 15, trap: out of scope 27% of 15.

g.text: Which kinds of task does it get right?
Pass rate and outcome mix per task tag, best first; a task carries several tags, all runs pooled. Dashed line: the
pass rate over all tasks. Tags with fewer than 10 tasks come last, faded: one task moves them a lot.

svg.text: Fewer than 10 tasks: hints, not findings
